## Add `jhudsl-robot` as a Collaborator

*Skip this step if your course is in the `jhudsl` or `fhdsl` organization.*

To enable the full functionality of GitHub Actions, add `jhudsl-robot` as a collaborator with write access:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Collaborators & Teams** and click **Add people**.
2. Search for and add `jhudsl-robot`.
3. If prompted, choose **Write** access, then click **Add jhudsl-robot to this repository**.

<img src="https://github.com/ottrproject/OTTR_Template/raw/main/resources/screenshots/add-jhudsl-robot.png" width="400">

---

## Which Sync File Should You Edit?

Add your repository name to the `.github/sync.yml` file of the OTTR template you created your repository from:

| Template | Sync File | Use For |
|:---|:---|:---|
| [OTTR_Template](https://github.com/ottrproject/OTTR_Template/blob/main/.github/sync.yml) | `sync.yml` | R Markdown courses |
| [OTTR_Template_Website](https://github.com/ottrproject/OTTR_Template_Website/blob/main/.github/sync.yml) | `sync.yml` | Websites |
| [OTTR_Quizzes](https://github.com/ottrproject/OTTR_Quizzes/blob/main/.github/sync.yml) | `sync.yml` | Quizzes |

---

## If You Are NOT in the `jhudsl` or `fhdsl` Organization

Choose one of the following options:

- **Google Form** — Submit your org/username and repo name via the [OTTR Feedback Google Form](https://forms.gle/jGQnd5oemHWyuUq28).
- **Open an issue** — Use the links below and provide your repo info; the team will update `sync.yml` for you.
- **Fork and PR** — Fork the template repo, edit `sync.yml` on a new branch adding your repo name where it says `#NEW REPO HERE#`, commit, and open a pull request tagging `@kweav`.

<details>
<summary><strong>
If You Are in the <code>jhudsl</code> or <code>fhdsl</code> Organization
</strong></summary>

1. Open the relevant sync file above and click the **pencil icon** to edit.
2. Add your repository name where it says `#NEW REPO HERE#`, indented to match other entries.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ottrproject/OTTR_Template/main/resources/screenshots/edit-sync.yml.png)

3. Click **Commit changes...**, enter `Add new repository to sync` as the commit message, and choose **Create a new branch**.
4. Click **Propose changes**, open a pull request, and request `@kweav` as a reviewer.
</details>

| Repository | Issue Links |
